verdict.rationale: Slack's first-party AI features docs explicitly state AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and serve daily recaps (slack-docs-15), backed by Slackbot as an intelligent daily briefing/agent (slack-docs-13, slack-docs-14) and huddle note-taking/recaps (slack-docs-19, slack-docs-34). This directly matches the story of AI-generated summaries/recaps of missed channels/threads. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of summary quality or accuracy, and no community evidence corroborating real-world reliability of this specific feature (community evidence pack focuses on unrelated pain points like pricing/export/threads UX).
